question: What Are PV, SV, TV and QV in HART Transmitters?
body_html:
Process variables in HART transmitters are the four values a smart transmitter reports. Only PV is sent on the 4 to 20 mA signal; all four are available digitally through HART on the same two wires.

VariableMeaning
PV, primaryMain measurement, mapped to 4 to 20 mA
SV, secondarySecond measured value, such as static pressure
TV, tertiaryDerived value used for compensation
QV, quaternaryFinal result, such as mass or totalized flow
